InstagramGrid.title: Discover more about my artistic world
InstagramGrid.description: In this space, I share my professional and personal journey, the processes behind each artwork, and moments that inspire my art. You can discover more and connect with me through Instagram.
InstagramGrid.profileDescription: Follow her art, processes, and posts on Instagram.

HeroSection.title: Companies & Collaborations
HeroSection.description: Projects I carried out for institutions, brands, and companies. Commissioned works, interventions, and collaborations that reflect my professional experience with various organizations and brands.

CarruselExpos.title: Exhibitions and Appearances
CarruselExpos.paragraph1: Throughout my career, I have had the opportunity to showcase my work in various exhibitions and art fairs, sharing spaces with other artists and connecting with diverse audiences.
CarruselExpos.paragraph2: This selection gathers other notable exhibitions, complementing the institutional collaborations and individual projects I have already presented. Each showcase reflects important moments of my career and artistic evolution.

item1.title: Municipal Museum of Art MUMART
item1.description: Solo exhibition “Cicatrices” (2025). Reflection on traces, memory, and reconstruction through material.

item2.title: FusiónARTE — City Bell
item2.description: Curated by Sebastián Guerrini (2025). Works in dialogue with the notion of reinvention and artistic transformation.

item3.title: Artweek Chile
item3.description: International participation in Santiago de Chile (2021-2022). Solo stand with large-format abstract works.

item4.title: Art & Deco — Palermo
item4.description: Solo exhibition (2023). Works presented at Art & Deco, a design and art space in Palermo Soho.
